notes.title: [v2.1.2] Bug fixes for the dress-up feature
notes.notes:
Thank you for using VRoid Studio.
VRoid Studio v2.1.2 update concerns the following:

■ Fixes

 Fixed an issue with XAvatar export, VRM export, and animation previews caused by duplicate bone names
 Fixed an issue where outfits became invisible during animation previews under certain conditions
 Fixed an issue where XAvatar or XWear containing hidden GameObjects could not be properly applied during outfit changes
 Fixed an issue that prevented VRM export with certain combinations of body models and outfits
 Fixed an issue where VRM export failed if the VRM model contained hidden renderers
 Fixed validation errors during VRM export for data using certain lilToon shader materials


This update resolves many commonly reported errors related to exporting and animation previews.
If you’ve experienced these errors before, please try again using this latest version.

We will keep looking out for your comments and feedback and work towards new updates.
Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: [XWear Stable Release Celebration] 23 new preset avatars have been added to VRoi
notes.notes:
To mark the launch of XWear, we’ve added 23 new preset avatars to VRoid Studio!

[previewyoutube=_7qHugprUNs;full][/previewyoutube]

These avatars are designed as dress-up models to help you explore and enjoy the full potential of XWear.

Try out the XWear feature in VRoid Studio to dress up and customize these avatars, and upload your creations to VRChat!


■ What is the XWear feature?
XWear is a simple dress-up tool for VRChat that allows you to…

 Use 3D items you made yourself or purchased on BOOTH
 Dress-up a variety of avatars, including made-from-scratch models
 Convert your creations into VRChat-compatible data

*XWear also includes other features like VRM export and easy outfit swaps for avatars created in VRoid Studio.

Learn more: https://vroid.com/en/news/26gn98sTuPJQ53LxDQRyFg


■ Find your next favorite avatar: Meet the full alphabet from A to Z!
Back in 2021, we introduced AvatarSample_A, B, and C. Now, we’re completing the set with avatars D through Z, giving us the full alphabet of avatars to explore in 2025’s expanding world of XWear and VRChat!

These avatars feature hairstyles, faces, and character designs created in VRoid Studio. The outfits they wear are also preset clothing from VRoid Studio.

Start customizing and transforming these avatars to make them truly your own and bring them to life in VRChat!


■ Where can I download them?
Open VRoid Studio, and you’ll find the new avatars on the avatar selection screen.
*The data for preset avatars will download the first time you select them.

▼Learn more: About Conditions of Use for Preset Models and Items
https://vroid.pixiv.help/hc/en-us/sections/900001865183


■ What are the Terms of Use of these models?
These new sample avatars follow the same Terms of Use as the existing ones.

▼Learn more: VRoidPreset_A - Z
https://vroid.pixiv.help/hc/en-us/articles/4402394424089


If you need assistance with XWear or the dress-up feature, please refer to the pages below.

▼XWear and dress-up feature help
https://vroid.pixiv.help/hc/en-us/sections/38546349380761--Dress-up-Feature

If you have additional questions or feedback, reach out via “Send opinions and feedback” in the form below.

▼Contact VRoid Studio support
https://www.pixiv.net/support?mode=select_type&service=vroid-studio

notes.title: Release of VRoid Studio v0.14.0
notes.notes:
Thank you for using VRoid Studio.
The list of updates for the VRoid Studio vv0.14.0 release are as follows.

■ New features

 The sample models AvatarSample_A, AvatarSample_B, and AvatarSample_C have been added
 18 new animations for female models have been added (including 10 poses)
 8 new animations for male models have been added (including 4 poses) 


■ Changes

 The sample models Shibu Sendagaya, Shino Sendagaya, and Fumiriya Sakurada have retired
 The sample model Darkness_Shibu has been renamed AvatarSample_D
 The sample model Vivi has been renamed AvatarSample_E
 The sample model Vita has been renamed AvatarSample_F
 The sample model Victoria_Rubin has been renamed AvatarSample_G
 Sample models can now be ordered by timestamp
 Copyright Waiver (CC0) when exporting VRM files for the new sample models has been disabled
 A link to Terms of Use for sample models has been added to the start screen


We're always striving to improve our services based on the requests and feedback from our users. Thank you for continuing to use VRoid!
